title: Close out mcp-crawl4ai and prove it works

questions.description: The audit already found the failures. This chooses the bundle of work. The recommendation is everything required for the documented path to start, the suite to pass, and the live tools to do what they claim, including the private-address check. Publishing to PyPI, merging Dependabot, and deleting the unused legacy functions stay out unless you add them.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Startup, CI, live-tool behavior, SSRF fail-closed, HTTP bind, and the false instructions.

options.label: Make the pinned interpreter start the server, and document uv run
Make pytest and ruff format pass on main
Fix truncation, capture flags, timeouts and viewport, and crawl depth
Fail closed on DNS errors, re-check discovered URLs, and reject host-parser confusion
Stop publishing unauthenticated HTTP on 0.0.0.0 by default
Correct the instructions that are currently false (tool count, dependencies, PATH, Python, /mcp)
Bump the version past the pre-rename 0.3.1 wheel, without publishing
Merge the five open Dependabot action bumps
Delete the unregistered legacy tool functions

questions.prompt: Which Python should the documented start path use?
questions.description: .python-version is 3.14, and locked httpcore 1.0.7 crashes on import there during FastMCP startup. The same lock imports on 3.13, which is what the Docker image uses. A later plain uv sync follows .python-version and returns to 3.14.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Pin the project, CI, and Docker to Python 3.13 so the documented command matches the interpreter that actually starts.

options.label: Pin .python-version, CI, ty, and Docker to 3.13
Keep 3.14 and upgrade the locked HTTP stack so startup works there
Support both 3.13 and 3.14, and make CI test both

questions.prompt: What should the HTTP server do when it is not on loopback?
questions.description: The CLI already defaults to 127.0.0.1 and prints a warning for other hosts. The Docker command binds 0.0.0.0 with no authentication. One browser and caller-chosen session ids are shared by every client.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Keep the CLI on loopback. Change the image default to loopback and require an explicit host override. Do not add a new auth system in this pass.

options.label: Loopback by default, including Docker, with an explicit host override
Require a bearer token before any HTTP tool call
Leave 0.0.0.0 in Docker and keep the stderr warning

questions.prompt: What has to be true before this close-out is done?
questions.description: Unit tests do not launch Chromium. A live crawl needs a browser and network. The recommendation proves the process starts and the suite is green, and leaves a real page fetch as a manual check.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Green pytest, green ruff format and ruff check, ty check, and the server process stays up on the chosen Python for stdio and for HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8000/mcp.

options.label: uv run pytest is green, including a valid JSON envelope after truncation
ruff check and ruff format --check pass
ty check passes
The server stays up on stdio on the chosen Python
HTTP listens on 127.0.0.1:8000/mcp
One live Chromium fetch of a public page succeeds
